docs.summary: Something in a scene that keeps state in the scene's [`RenderWorld`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.RenderWorld): a renderer, a light, a probe. It joins the scene's rendering when enabled and leaves when disabled, and pushes what changed once a frame.

Brings the world up to date with the component. Main thread, once a frame the scene renders. Returns true when the component is wholly in the world, nothing of it still loading, so while playing it is left alone until something wakes it: its Transform or an ancestor's moving, its GameObject's layer or static flag, a change to the mesh it draws, a lightmap rebake, or the component calling [`Wake`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Rendering.SceneRendering~Wake) from a setting it changed.
The mesh the component last synced, so editing that mesh wakes it.
Removes everything the component added to the world.
